tools.name: count_tokens
tools.description: Count tokens for a text string or chat messages array for any supported AI model (GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, Llama).

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate the cost of an AI API call given model and token counts or text. Returns input/output/total cost and optional monthly projection.

tools.name: get_model_pricing
tools.description: Get input/output pricing per 1M tokens for a specific AI model.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List all supported AI models with their pricing and context windows.
